overview_description.description:
SilverRail is an information technology company that specializes in the fields of passenger rail ticketing, travel distribution technology, and global rail access. SilverRail's technology is purpose built for rail. Our product suite spans the full customer experience.

It was founded in 2009 and headquartered in London, England.

about_short_description.short_description: SilverRail offers technical solutions that help railways and travel distributors easily connect with each other.

product.name: Ticket Issuing System
product.description: An integrated ticket issuing platform providing omnichannel retailing for rail operators to manage ticket sales and distribution.

product.name: Journey Planning
product.description: A rail journey planning tool that simplifies complex travel itineraries for customers and supports rail operators in managing travel options.

product.name: Rail Distribution
product.description: A multi-market API that enables retailers to sell global rail tickets by connecting to multiple rail carriers through a single interface.

product.name: White Label Rail Commerce
product.description: A customizable rail search and booking engine that integrates into websites or mobile apps for travel agencies and management companies.

product.name: Fulfilment
product.description: E-ticketing solutions that provide fast, seamless checkout and multiple payment options for purchasing train tickets.

product.name: Customer Service
product.description: Technology solutions that streamline passenger service operations, including handling exchanges, cancellations, refunds, and targeted promotional campaigns.
